Check out the free 3-day Master Prompt course here: https://luma.com/ympyjhav

Most AI rollouts don’t fail in the training room. They fail a few weeks later, when the team quietly goes back to the old workflow.

In this video, Hayden Miyamoto breaks down what quiet AI resistance actually looks like, why most AI adoption efforts stall even when leadership says all the right things, and the four conditions that have to change for AI to actually stick inside a company.

If you’re a founder, operator, CEO, or team lead trying to make AI part of how your company really works, this will help you see why adoption breaks down and what to do differently.

You’ll learn:
- what “quiet resistance” actually looks like
- why most AI rollouts never become behavior change
- the 4 gaps that stop adoption from sticking
- what a real AI adoption system looks like
- how to create early wins that build momentum
